title: CaseFacts[]
description: Grading facts of a full run, one entry per active case (packages/evals/src/release.ts computeFacts / runEval). validateFacts also checks that checked = verified + mismatched + unverified and that an ungraded entry (coverage_gap, error) has all counts 0 and platform null. partial_leaks appears only on an ungraded entry and only when non-empty: the L1 leak codes found in the turns the case completed before it stopped (and in what is readable of a malformed turn output), each once in code-unit order; the leak metrics add them to summary.counters. partial_checks appears only on an ungraded entry and is never all zero (runEval writes it when a completed turn holds a mismatched or unverified card value or link): the card_values and attribution counts of the turns the case completed before it stopped; the card_values and attribution metrics add them to the graded counts. Read by checkReleaseGate (BR-AI-21).

platform_expected.description: Only on an ungraded case with an expected args.platform; stopped T1 cases remain in the platform metric denominator.

leakCodes.description: Non-empty, each code once, in code-unit order.

partialChecks.description: Card value and attribution counts of the completed turns of a stopped case; not both all zero.
